name: Mirror
source:
Main character falls from a cliff during a ski trip. He miraculously survives and being unable to climb up the cliff he walks into a lodge in the woods. He stays for the night, but at night the master of the house gets killed. He's unable to leave the house till the killer is found, so he decides to investigate the matter himself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一次滑雪旅行中从悬崖上坠落。他奇迹般地活了下来，但由于无法爬上悬崖，他走进了树林里的一间小屋。他留下来过夜，但夜里主人被杀了。在找到凶手之前，他无法离开家，因此他决定亲自调查此事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
